coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore, hyphen or comb run: the characters' box (first to last character). Text tick box "/ /" or "[ ]": the three characters' box. Drawn rule: its x extent and the 10 pt above it. Drawn box: its rectangle.
how_measured: pdfplumber drawn lines (each rule exact) and characters; box glyphs measured on a 400 dpi render; every page looked at at 100 dpi; overlays looked at.

signing.kind: Exhibit C subscription agreement and power of attorney of a commodity pool LP (filed PDF). Individuals sign F.1 with a co-subscriber; an entity signs F.2 by an authorised signatory. No acceptance block for the general partner and no broker or custodian block is printed. Exhibit D (pages 9-10) is a separate short form for existing investors buying more units, with its own individual and entity signature columns. Pages 11-12 are Part II of the registration statement, not part of the form.
signing.individual_and_entity: separated: F.1 individual or joint (page 7) and F.2 entity (page 8); Exhibit D has an individuals column and an entity column (page 10)
